immutable_scientific_contract.geometry: B32, 32 Q heads, 16 KV heads, head_dim 256, page size 16, HND BF16 cache, window_left 1023, split-KV true, padded batch 64
immutable_scientific_contract.stock: vLLM reshape_and_cache_flash through the corrected NHD-ordered view of shared HND storage followed by the exact pinned TRT-LLM Gen consumer
immutable_scientific_contract.candidate: the correctness-proven FlashInfer split reducer that preserves native split (V,LSE), masks the stale final cache row, merges fresh K/V once in the final reducer, and assigns one cache owner per GQA2 pair
immutable_scientific_contract.sample_order: deterministic alternating pairs with 20 stock-first and 20 candidate-first pairs
immutable_scientific_contract.timed_region: CUDA events around only the complete stock append-plus-consumer or candidate fused consumer; exclude JIT, allocation, tensor construction, planning, serialization, and artifact I/O
immutable_scientific_contract.synchronization: synchronize before the first sample and after each recorded CUDA event pair
immutable_scientific_contract.output_consumption: consume complete final outputs and mutated cache state after timing
immutable_scientific_contract.correctness_guards: retain finite output, full-cache bitwise equality, rtol 0.05, atol 0.03, cosine >=0.999, exact split plan, one KV owner, and one fresh merge
immutable_scientific_contract.whole_request_projection: multiply stock-minus-candidate milliseconds per B32 local-attention call by 17,900 local-layer decode calls and divide by 1000

report: stock and candidate p10, p50, p90 milliseconds
paired delta distribution and deterministic bootstrap 95% interval
projected seconds saved per request over 17,900 local-attention calls
all correctness guards and source identities
timing_decision.positive: paired median delta is positive, its deterministic bootstrap 95% lower bound is above zero, and every correctness and structural guard passes
timing_decision.negative: candidate median is no faster or a finite structurally valid timing result fails the promotion rule
timing_decision.incomplete: build, import, runtime, nonfinite, structural, or artifact failure before an interpretable paired timing terminal

mutable_execution_scope.required_before_owner_launch: hash-bind the timing runner, owner, preclaim terminal, correctness terminal, repaired candidate sources, and pinned identities
permitted_repairs: ordinary timing harness, CUDA-event, import, path, permission, container, serialization, retrieval, and launcher defects
hash-bound project-local repair tar under the continuous claim
forbidden: change to geometry, producer, consumer, cache semantics, reducer algebra, split plan, correctness gates, or source implementation
include planning, allocation, JIT, serialization, or I/O in either timed region
replay the consumed correctness-only pair or the failed tail-output candidate
modify provider lifecycle or the M32 dispatcher

researcher_execution.launch_sequence: Claim by 20:50Z, implement and hash-bind the three named timing artifacts inside the continuous claim, then launch the repair-capable owner by 20:56Z.
researcher_execution.durable_owner: Atomically record PID, start ticks, state path, artifact root, bench, phase, expected terminal, and 2026-07-28T21:02:00Z deadline in STATUS.json.active_session.

terminal_dispositions.positive: Persist the interpretable timing terminal, release the unoccupied bench available, and wake the director for endpoint-integration selection.
terminal_dispositions.decision_bearing_negative: Persist the interpretable paired timing terminal and release the unoccupied bench available by 2026-07-28T21:02:00Z.
terminal_dispositions.incomplete_or_uninterpretable: Retain the continuous claim for bounded same-claim repair only while repair, terminal, and safe disposition still fit before 2026-07-28T21:02:00Z.
terminal_dispositions.deadline_or_unsafe: At the absolute disposition fence, or if the guest is unsafe or unreachable, persist the diagnostic and release to maintenance for director handling.
